'''Noah''' (Japanese: '''クワシ''' ''Kuwashi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM113|This Magik Moment!]]''.

Noah and his {{p|Pikipek}} participated in the Alola Pokémon Quiz on [[Alola TV]]. During the preliminary round, he faced off against {{an|Sophocles}} and two other contestants. Noah and Sophocles both answered multiple questions correctly, and in the end, it came down to one last question. Noah answered the question correctly before Sophocles and subsequently moved on to the final round.

During the final round, Noah faced off against a girl and her {{p|Oricorio}}, with the final question being "[[Who's That Pokémon?|Who's that Pokémon?]]". As Noah answered with "{{p|Gyarados}}", a Gyarados actor called Karpy rampaged through the television studio. Despite this, Noah's answer was correct, causing him to win the quiz. Sophocles, who was chasing Karpy, overheard Noah's win and congratulated him.
